main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean 14-bar excess return on positive-forecast grid bars

statistic.name: t of the weighted mean, cases of one day summed

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 (and slope > 0); reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of excess 14-bar return on forecast

decided_by: The t lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: The normal drift is each coin's mean 14-bar return on the non-overlapping grid of all its windows, and the day-clustered t sums the weighted deviations f*(x-mean) per UTC day with a D/(D-1) correction, the standard error being divided by the sum of forecasts.
